issue_request: FHIR-11137 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request for FHIR-core Observation. It asked to clarify the ambiguous genomic source class wording, "Source of sample used to determine the sequence in sequencing lab -- germline, somatic, prenatal," and its resolution said to point to the LOINC definition, work with LOINC to redefine the term, and update the FHIR definition accordingly once redefined.
initial_application: No explicit HL7/fhir commit mentioning FHIR-11137 was found. Historical core source shows partial application in the old Observation genetics artifacts: earlier spreadsheet/profile content defined genomic source class as the category of tissue-sample source and listed LOINC answers, while later R4/R4B extension source still retained the shorter germline/somatic/prenatal wording. Those old clinical genomics artifacts were later removed from current core source.
additional_context: Current core source has no active observation-geneticsGenomicSourceClass definition and fhir.ini has no active profile/extension entry for the old Observation genetics content. The canonical definition now found locally is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions, where StructureDefinition-observation-geneticsGenomicSourceClass.json is retired/deprecated and directs implementers to the Genomics Reporting Guide, but still contains the older wording. FHIR-8033 is supporting context because it previously defined genomic source class as tissue-sample source and recorded the LOINC answer list.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. A core source edit would not affect a current build-owned artifact; any remaining source correction belongs in HL7/fhir-extensions.
